headline: Improved performance aided by Subansiri and Teesta V

highlights: Consequently, standalone revenues grew 55% YoY to ~INR 44bn, with an EBITDA of ~INR 29bn (+78% YoY), which led to adj.
Revenue at Subansiri and Parbati II is being recognised at 80% of the cost, with a final tariff order expected soon.

Operating parameters improve, aided by new capacity… NHPC’s PAF availability was healthy during the quarter at 92.24% vs. 78.58% YoY, as consolidated generation grew 17% YoY to ~14BU, anchored by 1) commissioning of a unit at lower Subansiri, 2) improved performance at Parbati II, and 3) resumption of operations at Teesta-V.
INR 12bn in the year-ago quarter and INR 14bn in the preceding quarter, despite revenue from Subansiri and Parbati being booked at 80% of the capex.
valuation: We maintain REDUCE with an unchanged target price of INR 72, valuing the stock at 10x FY28E standalone EPS of INR 6.2/share, its subsidiaries at 2.5x regulated equity, and its RE portfolio at 11x FY28E EV/EBITDA.
The views and opinions expressed in this document may or may not match or may be contrary with the views, estimates, rating, and target price of the Retail Research.
watch: Risks: 1) Delay in execution of hydro and RE projects; and 2) better-than-expected incentive income.
The recipient should independently evaluate the investment risks.
